description: Immutable legacy collective oracle: real PulseDB database bytes written by PulseHive 2.0.2 crates against pulsehive-db 0.5.1 through the builtin all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding path. Pre-upgrade oracle for the PulseDB 0.7 migration (r1.s4.w3).
provenance_notes: Generated in a temporary checkout of pulsehive_commit obtained via 'git archive a9f7839 | tar -x'. That commit is the first PulseHive 2.0.2-crate commit whose root Cargo.toml requires pulsehive-db = "0.5"; Cargo resolved it to pulsehive-db 0.5.1 (temp-checkout Cargo.lock: name = "pulsehive-db", version = "0.5.1", source = "registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"). The published tag v2.0.2 (0969c8e) pins PulseDB 0.4 and is explicitly not the source. Ids, timestamps and the sha256 were generated by PulseDB 0.5.1 at run time and are captured here; the bytes are pinned by sha256, not claimed bit-reproducible.

experiences.label: exp-embeddings
experiences.content: PulseHive opens its substrate on PulseDB with builtin all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings whenever no external embedding provider is configured.

experiences.label: exp-persistence
experiences.content: Experiences submitted with embedding None are embedded internally by PulseDB 0.5.1 before they are persisted to the collective.

experiences.label: exp-collective-identity
experiences.content: A collective is a name-scoped namespace; get_or_create_collective returns the same id across HiveMind instances for one name.
